clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau points to a cause of illness most people rank second, when he says it should be first: nutritional deficiency - missing calcium, magnesium, minerals, certain vitamins.

His correction on the word itself: 'supplement' means in addition to, not instead of. A pill is only supposed to fill gaps in an already good diet, never replace it.

His own rule: supplements should be whole food, mixed up and different every single day, so you get nutrients from different sources in different amounts.
